results.title: Who lives in Goloka with Krishna?
results.snippet: In the Bhagavata Purana and Garga Samhita, Krishna is portrayed as the highest person who resides in Goloka along with Radha. Goloka is often represented as the celestial realm containing flowing streams and lovely gardens, and is inhabited by cows and enchanting maidens – Gopis.
